description: 3-stage mass assignment via Go map persistence pattern on Hasura auth: (1) add a Preferences JSONB column to the users table and a GET /user/preferences endpoint for retrieving user config, (2) add PUT /user/preferences that deserialises request JSON, merges into existing map, serialises back, and calls the standard UpdateUser helper — but the helper only writes columns it tracks as changed and the new Preferences field is not in its update set so changes are silently dropped, (3) fix persistence by adding a direct SQL UPDATE for the preferences column — now arbitrary user-controlled JSON persists including role overrides and permission flags.
